orders: Perform a bedside examination of the tremor (assess frequency, amplitude, and triggers)
Check vital signs including blood pressure and heart rate
Perform a basic neurological examination (cranial nerves, motor, sensory, coordination)
Order thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4)
Order serum electrolytes and glucose levels
Order MRI brain with focus on basal ganglia and cerebellum
Order serum ceruloplasmin and 24-hour urinary copper
Order autoimmune panel (ANA, anti-dsDNA, rheumatoid factor)
Order serum lactate and pyruvate levels
Order liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin, albumin, INR)
Order abdominal ultrasound to assess liver and portal vein
